# AI ConnectX

> Frontier Student Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Systems Organization at VIT Bhopal University.

## Core Mission
AI ConnectX is a student-led AI engineering community dedicated to democratizing frontier artificial intelligence, agentic architectures, neural systems, and cross-campus collaborative intelligence.

## Official Canonical URLs
- Primary Gateway: https://aiconnectx.club/
- Research & Mission: https://aiconnectx.club/overview

- Terms of Service: https://aiconnectx.club/terms
